typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		ENTITY_ID as decimal(38,0),
		ENTITY_FIELD_NAME as string,
		OLD_VALUE as string,
		NEW_VALUE as string,
		AUDIT_ACTION as string,
		MODIF_DATE as timestamp
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive(loadDate = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn2
DerivedColumn2 sink(input(
		newValue as string,
		modifDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		auditAction as string,
		entityId as string,
		entityFieldName as string,
		oldValue as string,
		loadDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		newValue = NEW_VALUE,
		modifDate = MODIF_DATE,
		auditAction = AUDIT_ACTION,
		entityId = ENTITY_ID,
		entityFieldName = ENTITY_FIELD_NAME,
		oldValue = OLD_VALUE,
		loadDate),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
